DETAILS: Sea the Wonder is a lovely 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home located in Seacrest Beach that can accommodate 10 guests. Take advantage of shopping and dining options that are just a short walk away, private beach access, and a large resort-style community pool! The first floor of the home boasts an open-plan living area, along with plenty of windows that fill the indoor space with brilliant natural light. The well-appointed kitchen features all the items needed to make spectacular meals for friends or family. Guests can enjoy their meals at a dining table that seats 8, or at the breakfast bar with room for 2. The living room is just off the dining area. It features a cozy sofa, 2 comfortable armchairs, and a 65” TV. This is the perfect spot to kick back and enjoy a movie with friends and family. There are 2 bedrooms on the first floor—one with a queen bed and a 43” TV—and another bedroom with 4 built-in twin bunks, along with a 43” TV. These bedrooms share a bathroom with a shower/tub combo. And don’t forget about the spectacular screened-in porch just down the hall from the bedrooms! With comfortable outdoor seating and a dining table that can accommodate 8, this is the ideal spot to enjoy meals al fresco or relax with a cup of coffee in the morning as the sun comes up. Guests will find 2 bedrooms on the second floor. The primary bedroom has a king bed, a 55” TV, a private bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower, and access to a private front balcony. The second bedroom features a king bed, a 43” TV, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The third floor boasts a small living area, a wet bar with a mini fridge, a comfortable sofa, and a 43” TV. Do not miss the chance to stay at Sea the Wonder. Guests may also explore all that Seacrest Beach has to offer on 4 included adult bikes. Book your next 30A beach vacation today!
